rows.question: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.query_en: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.answer: Use of pre-emergence and early post-emergence herbicides provides effective control of grass weeds. For instance, applying Pyrazosulfuron ethyl @ 20 g/ha or Butachlor 1.0 l/ha or Pendimethalin 1.0 l/ha on the 3rd or 4th day after sowing can control weeds in the lowland nursery.

rows.question: धान की नर्सरी में घास वाले खरपतवार कैसे नियंत्रित करें?
rows.query_en: How to control weeds in a paddy nursery
rows.answer: Weed control in a paddy nursery can be managed through mechanical transplanting with a spacing of 30x12 cm [1]. After transplanting, interculture with a Paddy Weeder 15 days later and again after a fortnight [1]. Alternatively, hand weeding can be done where a paddy weeder cannot be run [1]. Pre-emergence herbicides like Pyrazosulfuron ethyl @ 20 g/ha or Butachlor 1.0 l/ha can also be applied on 3rd or 4th day after sowing [4].

rows.question: How much zinc sulphate should I apply to transplanted paddy for zinc deficiency?
rows.query_en: How much zinc sulphate should I apply to transplanted paddy for zinc deficiency?
rows.answer: Apply 25 kg of zinc sulphate heptahydrate (21%) or 16 kg zinc sulphate monohydrate (33%) per acre at puddling if the previous crop in the field had shown symptoms of zinc deficiency. Where deficiency symptoms appear in the growing crop, apply 10 kg of zinc sulphate heptahydrate (21%) or 6.5 kg zinc sulphate monohydrate (33%) per acre mixed with an equal quantity of dry soil along rows.

rows.question: कपास में गुलाबी सुंडी को अगले मौसम तक पहुँचने से कैसे रोकें?
rows.query_en: How to prevent the pink sundae in cotton from reaching the next season?
rows.answer: गुलाबी कीड़ा को अगले मौसम तक पहुंचने से रोकने के लिए एसिड - इसे बेचने या बोने से पहले बीज को छान लें क्योंकि यह उपचार गुलाबी कीड़ा के लार्वा को मार देता है । इसके अतिरिक्त यदि बीज को बुवाई के लिए बनाए रखना है तो मार्च के अंत तक इसका अम्ल उपचार किया जाना चाहिए और मवेशियों को खिलाया नहीं जाना चाहिए ।
rows.answer_en: To prevent the pink bollworm from reaching the next season, acid-delint the seed-cotton before selling or sowing it, as this treatment kills the larvae of the pink bollworm [3]. Additionally, if seed is to be retained for sowing, it should undergo acid treatment by the end of March and not be fed to cattle [3].

rows.question: పత్తిలో గులాబీ రంగు కాయ తొలుచు పురుగు తర్వాతి సీజన్‌కు రాకుండా ఎలా ఆపాలి?
rows.query_en: How to stop the pink leaf borer in cotton from coming in the next season?
rows.answer: To prevent the pink bollworm from coming in the next season, after the final picking, shred the infested cotton field to kill the larvae [3]. Also, fumigate the seed left uncrushed in the mills before the end of April with Celphos/Phostoxin/Delicia @ one 3-g tablet per cubic metre space, giving an exposure of 48 hours or use two tablets with an exposure of 24 hours [1].
